# Cal/OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training

> Annual 8-hour online HAZWOPER refresher for California workers who have completed initial HAZWOPER training, in accordance with Cal/OSHA Title 8, Section 5192, paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulations: Cal/OSHA Title 8, Section 5192 (a)–(q); 29 CFR 1910.120(e); 29 CFR 1926.65(e)
- Frequency: required every 12 months after initial HAZWOPER training
- Prerequisite: initial Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER training
- Duration: 8 hours; 7 modules, 33 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.8 CEU
- Price: $149.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Other formats: SCORM, virtual instructor-led, in-person
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish; progress saved, but finish a section once started
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months; wallet card available as an add-on

## Who it is for
Equipment operators, general laborers, other site workers, and on-site managers and supervisors in uncontrolled hazardous waste or emergency response operations.

## Modules
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Toxicology
3. Hazard Classification
4. Personal Protective Equipment
5. HAZWOPER Site Operations
6. Material Sampling and Analysis
7. Emergency Response Procedures
